scope: Federal civil immigration detention challenges; general educational source directory

points.title: Different paths for different claims
points.text: A challenge to immigration detention under §2241 differs from a state-conviction §2254 petition, a federal-sentence §2255 motion and a petition for review of a final removal order. Check which procedure applies.

points.title: Find the court sources for the place of confinement
points.text: Core physical-custody habeas ordinarily starts with the district of confinement and immediate custodian. Respondent and venue questions require controlling law and current orders; a map boundary alone does not decide them.

points.title: Use current local instructions
points.text: Check local rules, §2241 forms, standing orders, judge procedures, filing and emergency instructions. An older form or state-conviction packet may not address immigration detention.

limits: Court source retrieval is not a complete district-specific substantive rules or citator audit.
Filing a petition does not itself guarantee release or automatically stay removal or transfer.
Case-specific court orders govern actual response and briefing deadlines.
